extracted.name: Brown Butter Banana Bread
extracted.description: Great recipe for Brown Butter Banana Bread.
ingredient_lines: 3 overripe bananas (if not overripe put in on a baking tray and place in oven until banana peel turns black, let cool and then use)
instruction_lines: In a medium saucepan, make the brown butter and set over medium heat. Stir the butter occasionally until it turns amber in color and develops little brown specks. Transfer the brown butter to a medium sized mixing bowl. Set the brown butter aside to cool for 10 minutes.
Mix brown butter with brown sugar.
Mash 3 bananas to add to mixture. Mix throughly.
Add vanilla extract and egg. Mix again.
In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Gently fold dry mixture into wet mixture.
Place batter into loaf pan and sprinkle brown sugar and extra chocolate on top.
Allow it to sit and cool for an hour before cutting into the banana bread. Enjoy!!
